blocks.text: KATSEYE member Megan Skiendiel briefly left her chair to join a dance break during the group’s Dallas concert on Nov. 11, just one day after performing an entire show seated while recovering from a concussion. The 20-year-old singer did not take a hiatus from the WILDWORLD Tour. However, her brief return to dancing sparked widespread concern from fans. Concertgoers also noticed what looked like a bedazzled heart rate monitor strapped to her torso.
